newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dumai 27,500-bpd cracker shut after fire - sources.
newsitem.headline: Dumai 27,500-bpd cracker shut after fire - sources.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina has shutdown a 27,500-barrel-per-day (bpd) hydrocracker following a fire at the refinery, sources close to the refinery said on Monday.
Pertamina officials said earlier on Monday that production had not been affected by a fire which occurred at the 125,000-bpd refinery on Friday.
"Friday's fire did not affect operations or production as it was put out an hour later," an offical told Reuters by telephone in Jakarta.
But trading sources close to the refinery in Singapore said the fire disrupted one of the refinery's two 27,500-bpd hyrdrocrackers and the unit was shut down.
It was expected to restart in late April.
According to Indonesian newspaper, Kompas, the explosion triggered panic among local residents because it was heard as far as 25 kilometres (16 miles) away.
